name: Google Meet
description: Google Meet is Google's video conferencing service for business communication, offering HD video calls, screen sharing, and Gemini-powered AI meeting features within Google Workspace.
best_for: Individuals, businesses, schools, and healthcare providers already in the Google ecosystem who need HIPAA-compliant video meetings integrated with Workspace.
features: HD video calls up to 1080p with screen sharing from Docs, Sheets, and Slides
Real-time live captions and noise cancellation
Gemini integration for automatic meeting summaries and real-time translation
Breakout rooms, interactive polls, and Q&A
Support for up to 1,000 participants and extended meeting durations on premium plans
Free tier supporting up to 100 participants and 60-minute group calls

alternatives.name: Zoom
alternatives.description: A video conferencing platform for meetings, webinars, and team chat used widely across businesses and education.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing reliable, widely adopted video conferencing

alternatives.name: Microsoft Teams
alternatives.description: A collaboration hub combining chat, video meetings, and file sharing tightly integrated with Microsoft 365.
strengths: Chat and video in one app

alternatives.name: Webex
alternatives.description: Cisco's AI-powered collaboration platform for video meetings, webinars, calling, and messaging.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting video, calling, and messaging with in-house AI transcription
